verdict.rationale: Gaudi 3 is a datacenter AI accelerator, but publishing board power, connector, and cooling specs is still a fair question for any add-in accelerator card, so the axis applies. The pack contains no first-party TDP/TBP figure, power-connector requirements, or cooling guidance. The only power detail is an unofficial community remark that the lower-power cards draw about 600W, and the PCIe form-factor mention says nothing about power or thermals.
